image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a Dungeness crab (Cancer magister). The image focuses on the anterior portion of the crab, highlighting the broad, reddish-brown carapace with lighter mottling. Two large, robust claws (chelipeds) are prominent in the foreground, showing white/cream coloration with red tips and serrated inner edges. Stalked eyes are visible protruding from the front margin of the carapace. The background is a blurred, warm-toned surface, likely a table or display case.
